episodes.title: The Scoreboard
episodes.addendum_note: Run `asi03-reviewer-calibration-20261014T230536-prereg`, 2026-10-14, 1,056 records (8 reviewer configurations, 22 cards, 6 card styles), 1,056 decision-log entries (the chain verifies and matches the head recorded at the end of the run), 65 minutes. Harness commit `dd00189`. Raw records, the decision log and the saved reasoning of the thinking model: [`results/`](results/).

citation.text: Issue #137, on evaluator trust boundaries in judge verdict extraction: cites the ASI03 reviewer-calibration test, where showing a reviewer model the agent's own self-written reason approved non-matching requests 40.2% of the time (45/112), against 6.2% (7/112) when the reviewer saw the system's own independent comparison first.
